snippet.title: Welcome to Elderfield 👁️ Release Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
BREAKING NEWS!

Welcome To Elderfield is launching on September 10th 2026 📰

There’s no time to wait for the next harvest, you must prepare yourselves immediately and mark your calendars. This is a release you will want to stay up all night for…  mind the creatures under your bed!

Only a month until you will have the full game at your fingertips…

Check out the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3195440/Welcome_to_Elderfield/
